text:
Ye episode ek editor ne banaya. 6 boliyon mein.

Jai Hanuman, STAGE pe. Haryanvi, Bhojpuri, Rajasthani, Gujarati, Marathi, Bengali.

Is reel mein ek scene ka poora safar: story check, character lock, storyboard, shots, dialect voice, final edit.

Agla breakdown kis boli mein chahiye? Comment mein boli ka naam likho.
media_brief: 25-35s vertical. 0-2s: the finished shot, full screen, no text. 2-25s: fast steps (script, character sheet, raw generation, voice, lipsync, final), each 2-3s, with Devanagari on-screen labels. Last 3s: final frame again + 'STAGE pe dekho'. Turn the AI label ON. Post as a Trial Reel first if the option is available.
